entities.summary: Mongolia International University is a private institution of tertiary education located in Bayanzürkh, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. It was established in 2002 on land gifted to it by former Mongolian president Natsagiin Bagabandi. It is an English-speaking university that offers 14 recognized bachelor’s programs.
